ABOUT THIS PROJECT

Useful before promotional.

Psyche Recommends is an independent Cult of Psyche project for people who earn, stream, freelance, and move money online.

Why these guides exist

Financial product pages often start with the sale. We start with the job: putting a clear payment link on a stream, paying a moderator, or understanding what an overdraft buffer can and cannot cover.

The referral is one possible next step. It is not the whole page.

Who writes and reviews them

The Psyche Recommends editorial desk researches, writes, and maintains these guides. Provider claims are checked against official product pages, terms, agreements, or support documentation linked from the article.

Drafting and code may use AI assistance. Financial claims are checked against the cited provider sources before publication.

How the site makes money

Some buttons use referral links. If a reader signs up and satisfies the provider’s current requirements, the site owner may receive a reward. Those links are labeled beside the button and marked as sponsored in the page code.

A referral does not change provider-controlled account approval, eligibility, limits, pricing, or rewards.

What this site is not

Psyche Recommends is not Cash App, Ally Bank, Twitch, a bank, or a financial adviser. The guides provide general educational information, not individualized financial, tax, or legal advice.

Corrections

Products change. Every financial guide carries a provider-review date and links to the source that should control if our summary and the provider’s current language differ.

Corrections can be proposed through the public project repository.
